title: ID0433067-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000689]Abnormal noise coming from the cooling fans
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
We have identified an abnormal noise coming from the cooling fans
of the station.
The noise is repetitive and suggests possible contact with internal
cabling or components. It may indicate a mounting or alignment
issue within the fan assembly.
Please investigate and advise on corrective measures.
Solution: N/A

Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0433067 ﻿from the
Technical Support

eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Customer noticed that the built-in fan making a noise when it is in operation.
We need to identify the source of the noise,
As per Our assumptions, Corrective Measures are as follows:
1. If GQ1 Fan is faulty - For this, We need to investigate and May have spares. - For schematic, You can refer to the schematic as mentioned in the KA
Emobility_SICD_HW_FAN_Error Flag_OK Signal Lost
2. If Something is obstructing the GQ1 fan - We need to check if any wire or anything Obstacting and take corrective action
3. Loose wiring - We need to investigate and take corrective action accordingly.
4. Also, we need to check if the Filters are not dirty
5. There is no obstacle in the path of Air Circulation
Also, customer mentioned that -
We have identified an abnormal noise coming from the cooling fans of the station. The noise is repetitive and suggests possible contact with internal cabling or components. It may indicate a mounting or alignment issue within the fan assembly.
